676:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But we must do our best in the battles ahead... The $$天翅$$'s 120 million years of rage and hatred have been entrusted to us...)

676:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, $$トライア$$... You've found time in your busy schedule to visit the $$Ｄトレーダー$$...」

676:t_10:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spare me the flattery. ...How are our $$Ｚチップ$$ savings coming along?」

676:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We somehow reached our target amount. I believe the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ can now produce the power we want.」

676:t_10:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then I'll start preparing on my end too.」

676:t_10:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Still, we may never even get a chance to play this trump card...」

676:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no use being negative! We need a little pick-me-up at a time like this!」

676:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

676:t_10:28.en:
$$トライア$$
「Heh heh... Once you try saying it, it really grows on you.」

676:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, it does! They're like magic words!」

677:t_000:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「After checking the coordinates, we believe this is the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld the $$フロンティア船団$$ was headed for!」

677:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So it's an Earth-like planet...!」

677:t_000:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I have confirmed $$アイランド１$$ behind us!」

677:t_001:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They probably fought $$バジュラ$$ outside their control and suffered heavy damage in a forced landing.」

677:t_001:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「It seems the $$バトル・フロンティア$$ has been detached...」

677:t_002:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is that... the $$バトル・フロンティア$$?!」

677:t_002:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Judging by the readings, we believe it has mechanically fused with a queen-class $$バジュラ$$!」

677:t_002:2.en:
$$三島$$
「$c...! You Folded straight to this planet's surface!」

677:t_002:3.en:
$$三島$$
「That's fine. The fusion of the $$クィーン#vajra$$ with this ship will be complete soon. I just need to buy time until then.」

677:t_003:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ under the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s control and $$ストライカー#pilot$$'s forces are coming!」

677:t_003:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「From the looks of it, they already control most of the $$バジュラ$$...!」

677:t_003:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「And if even the $$バジュラ$$ queen has fallen into their hands...」

677:t_003:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But unless we win this battle, we cannot head for the center of the galaxy.」

677:t_003:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, launch! Here we settle things with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ and $$レオン・三島$$!」

677:t_004:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We came straight from the space $$ミカゲ$$ created to the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld...!」

677:t_004:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But he was still trying to fight...! He's bound to interfere in this battle too!」

677:t_004:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「That suits me. We'll deal with everyone in our way here before we head for the center of the galaxy.」

677:t_005:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I've been waiting for you, boss!」

677:t_005:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「She's gone to get $$シェリル$$.」

677:t_005:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We're bound to need their power in this battle too...!」

677:t_005:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「If the $$超時空シンデレラ$$'s song and...」

677:t_005:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...the $$銀河の妖精$$'s song become one...!」

677:t_005:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm sure we can do it!」

677:t_005:8.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Until then, I'll get things fired up!」

677:t_005:9.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You're raring to go, $$バサラ$$.」

677:t_005:10.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Of course I am! I'll blast my sound at those idiots doing something as stupid as waging war!」

677:t_005:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Our target is the $$バトル・フロンティア$$ fused with the $$バジュラ$$ queen!」

677:t_005:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「To reach it, we'll take out the forces guarding the front line!」

677:t_005:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The enemy vanguard consists of $$ストライカー#robot$$ units. Beware of high-mobility attacks.」

677:t_005:14.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll settle things with her here too!」

677:t_005:15.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Put your souls into it, you bastards! This is the moment of truth!」

677:t_005:17.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The Captain's pep talks give me a real thrill!」

677:t_005:19.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Heh heh... My blood is boiling.」

677:t_005:20.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! Now that we've come this far, we'll give it everything we've got!」

677:t_005:21.en:
$$レド$$
「...to protect the lives of everyone in this galaxy...!」

677:t_005:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's do this! We'll stop their selfish ambitions here!!」

677:t_006:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed the annihilation of the $$ストライカー#robot$$ forces.」

677:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「It isn't over yet. Until we defeat the original, our battle with her won't end.」

677:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed that $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$ is approaching.」

677:t_007:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have detected a unit approaching this airspace at high speed. I estimate its type to be a $$マシンキャリバー$$.」

677:t_007:1.en:
$$レド$$
「She's... the original $$ストライカー#pilot$$ is here!」

677:t_008:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am the $$人類支援啓蒙レギュレーションシステム$$. In other words, I am a being called God.」

677:t_008:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop helping the $$ギャラクシー船団$$! They only see humans and $$バジュラ$$ as tools for their ambitions!」

677:t_008:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「They view individuals as components of the whole, freeing them of the responsibility to think and judge while building a more rational society...」

677:t_008:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「That is a utopia free of all anxiety.」

677:t_008:5.en:
$$レド$$
「You approve of a world where humans lose their humanity?!」

677:t_008:6.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I ask you: what is humanity? Define it clearly.」

677:t_008:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will answer on Ensign $$レド$$'s behalf. Humanity is...」

677:t_008:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Wait, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. This is a question I must answer myself.」

677:t_008:10.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll tell you, $$ストライカー#pilot$$. Humanity is...」

677:t_008:11.en:
$$レド$$
「I myself, living here and now, am the answer.」

677:t_008:13.en:
$$レド$$
「I thought you wouldn't. You have no idea what angers me or what I'm fighting to protect.」

677:t_008:14.en:
$$レド$$
「How could someone like you understand me... or humans?!」

677:t_008:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will add that my answer is exactly the same as Ensign $$レド$$'s.」

677:t_008:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$... $$チェインバー#pilot$$...!」

677:t_008:17.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They sure told her! That's what I'd expect from our $$ガルガンティア船団$$'s representatives!」
